query:
UPDATE app.visit
           SET note_ct = CASE WHEN $4 THEN $5 ELSE note_ct END,
               check_in_at = coalesce($6, check_in_at),
               companions = coalesce($7, companions),
               version = version + 1, updated_at = now()
           WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND id = $2 AND version = $3
